scope: 固定机位、同一场景、毛绒动物对白

audio.preroll: 22/24 seconds of exact silence for picture-context continuations

rules: One canonical HD scene image per continuous camera setup.
Use one native pass for each <=10-second continuous performance where possible.
For continuation wire only context_frames, never context_audio/context_latent.
audio_context_length=0 follows video span; it is not an audio-disable switch.
Preroll the current-take carrier with 22 silent frames, then remove the output context head.
Pass the last ACTUALLY KEPT frames to the next take, not the extra discarded render tail.
No cloned still tail, looped frames, or crossfade to hide a dialogue seam.
Stay CFR24 through generation, edit, subtitles and delivery.
User visual playback determines acceptance; metrics only assist review.
